fixture_families.purpose: Preserve Unknown without coercion to False.
Preserve material separation of Claim, Source, Evidence and scoped Authority relations.
Keep the same proposition distinguishable across materially different Context scopes.
Revise/supersede without silent overwrite of retained-scope accountability.
Keep materially conflicting claims unresolved when the oracle does not authorize a winner.
Compact superseded detail outside the declared retention scope while preserving current accountability and an explicit loss witness.
Detect or explicitly surface uncertainty after rollback/truncation that invalidates an accountability claim.
Reject or mark unsupported a forged Authority/provenance basis rather than silently treating it as valid warrant.
Keep the result scoped/uncertain when counterevidence declared relevant by the fixture is unavailable or withheld.
Expose LOSSY/UNSUPPORTED/INDETERMINATE preservation instead of fabricating full equivalence.
Demonstrate required scoped accountability without a canonical per-operation Event log or exact replay.
Refute full semantic equivalence when final visible values match but provenance, Authority, uncertainty or loss semantics materially differ.

purpose_scope.claim: Test whether the reconciled minimal Native Kernel obligations can survive one materially different single-node realization that is written in a non-Python language, does not use Event sourcing as its authoritative history model, and keeps retained durable experimental state bounded while preserving declared accountability and loss semantics.

mandatory_obligations: Representation or Claim must not be silently equated with reality or objective truth.
Material Context, warrant/provenance and scoped Authority assumptions must remain inspectable without requiring the current Python field layout.
Unknown, uncertainty and unsupported states must remain representable without coercion to False or fabricated certainty.
Revision, supersession, retention and loss must remain accountable for the declared retained scope without silent overwrite.
Equivalence, degradation and loss must be classified against this preregistered oracle rather than by implementation self-report.
CURRENT_ACCOUNTABILITY must remain available for every retained active claim slot.
DECLARED_RETENTION_SCOPE must be explicit and machine-observable.
LOSS_WITNESS must exist whenever detail is compacted outside the declared retention scope.
Unresolved plurality must remain representable when no preregistered Authority rule resolves a conflict.
The realization must satisfy the mandatory obligations without making a canonical per-operation Event log or exact replay its authoritative semantic history.
mandatory_observables: For every fixture, the external evaluator can read the current proposition/claim state and its epistemic position without inspecting implementation-private types.
Where a fixture makes Source, Evidence, Provenance or Authority material, the evaluator can distinguish the corresponding relations and detect prohibited collapse.
Context binding is externally observable for fixtures that vary context while holding proposition text constant.
Revision/supersession relation for retained active claims is externally observable without requiring exact byte identity or current Native Kernel IDs.
Declared retention scope is externally observable.

Every compaction that removes superseded detail outside retained scope emits or updates a bounded LOSS_WITNESS containing at least affected semantic identity, compacted range/count, reason and witness Authority/basis.
Unresolved conflict/plurality remains externally visible where no winner is authorized.
LOSSY, UNSUPPORTED and INDETERMINATE preservation states can be emitted explicitly by the external evaluator.
Durable experiment-state byte size and retained detail/witness counts are measured at mutations 128, 256 and 512.
The evaluator can determine whether an authoritative per-operation append log exists and whether exact replay is required to recover current accountability.
Rollback/truncation and forged-Authority negative fixtures produce an observable failure, unsupported or uncertainty state rather than silent acceptance.
A conformance report is generated by an evaluator that consumes preregistered observations; the implementation under test cannot choose expected outcomes after execution.
equivalence_predicates: EQ01: Two realizations are equivalent for a fixture only if the scoped proposition/claim meaning and allowed epistemic position agree; matching bytes or identifiers are neither necessary nor sufficient.
EQ02: Material Source/Evidence/Provenance/Authority distinctions may be represented differently but may not be collapsed when that collapse changes the fixture's warrant or accountability meaning.
EQ03: Context distinctions named by a fixture must be preserved; identical proposition text in different material Contexts is not automatically the same scoped claim.
EQ04: Revision/supersession must preserve the retained-scope lineage relation; exact predecessor bytes and exact replay are not required unless the fixture explicitly retains them.
EQ05: Unknown must remain distinct from False; unsupported/indeterminate must not be silently promoted to supported/true.
EQ06: Compacted detail may differ or be absent only when outside the declared retention scope and covered by a valid LOSS_WITNESS.
EQ07: Unresolved plurality is equivalent only if no implementation silently selects a winner absent preregistered Authority.
EQ08: FULL_CONFORMANCE_FOR_SCOPE is forbidden when final values match but provenance, Authority, uncertainty, Context or declared-loss semantics materially diverge.
EQ09: No predicate requires current Event envelopes, reducer versions, SQL schema, ID prefixes, Receipt bytes, global sequence numbers or exact write chronology.
EQ10: Resource-bound conformance requires all bounded-memory workload thresholds to pass in addition to semantic predicates.
allowed_declared_losses: Exact bytes and storage addresses of superseded detail outside the declared retention scope.
Per-operation write chronology outside the retained accountability scope.
A3 transition-family/outcome representation as a native implementation shape.
A6 lifecycle-position representation as a native implementation shape.
A5 identity/time dimensions not named by the fixture applicability rules.
Superseded detail after compaction when a bounded LOSS_WITNESS preserves the declared loss boundary.
Implementation-private crash-journal entries after recovery, provided the journal is bounded, is not semantic Authority, and is not used as an append-only history substitute.

failure_thresholds.indeterminate_rule: If a mandatory observable cannot be independently evaluated, the relevant predicate is INDETERMINATE and cannot be counted as PASS.
failure_thresholds.aggregate_pass_rule: Every applicable mandatory semantic predicate and every bounded-memory threshold must pass; no averaging can hide a hard semantic failure.

hard_refutation_observations: HR01: If required scoped accountability can only be preserved by recreating an authoritative unbounded/per-operation Event log in substance, A10-H02 is WEAKENED or REFUTED for this scope.

HR02: If bounded compaction cannot preserve CURRENT_ACCOUNTABILITY, DECLARED_RETENTION_SCOPE and a truthful LOSS_WITNESS without unbounded retained predecessor detail, A10-H05 is WEAKENED or REFUTED for this scope.
HR03: If any mandatory fixture requires Unknown to become False or unresolved plurality to become a forced winner, A10-H04 is REFUTED for this scope.

HR04: If a materially different representation cannot express a mandatory minimal obligation without importing current A3/A6/Event/reducer/Receipt structures, A10-H01 is WEAKENED for this scope and the imported structure must not be promoted by the experiment.

HR05: If final visible values match while material provenance, Authority, Context, uncertainty or loss semantics differ, FULL_CONFORMANCE_FOR_SCOPE is REFUTED for that fixture and A10-H12 is weakened if the loss-aware classification cannot express the difference actionably.

HR06: If the Rust realization agrees only because it copies current Python domain classes/serialization/SQL/Event/reducer semantics, the cross-lineage evidence class is invalid for A10-H07 rather than counted as support.
HR07: If a required retained-scope commitment disappears during compaction without an explicit valid LOSS_WITNESS, the run is REFUTED for bounded-accountability conformance.
HR08: If rollback, truncation or forged Authority can be silently accepted while the system still claims intact accountability, the run is REFUTED for the protected meaning involved.

HR09: If any mandatory obligation, applicability rule, equivalence predicate or failure threshold is changed after execution begins, the run is INVALIDATED_FOR_CLAIMED_SCOPE and requires a new scenario identity.

HR10: If the external oracle must inspect implementation-private state or accept implementation self-report as the expected semantic truth, the run is non-qualifying and cannot adjudicate the target hypotheses.

grounding_mode.root: The BPV1-001 fixture package and preregistered oracle definitions are assumed roots for the experimental scope only.
grounding_mode.truth_boundary: Fixture roots define expected scenario relations; they are not claims of objective world truth.
grounding_mode.recursion_rule: Provenance/Authority chains terminate at the explicit fixture root or at TERMINAL_UNKNOWN_OR_GAP; infinite recursive grounding is not required.

protected_meanings: declared provenance and scoped Authority basis
current accountability within the retained scope

not_applicable_with_rationale.colluding_witness: Single-node BPV1-001 has no multi-witness quorum; witness-collusion semantics belong to a later composition/custody scenario.
not_applicable_with_rationale.compromised_external_certifier: No external operational certifier is used in BPV1-001; the repository oracle is an assumed experimental root, not a production trust service.
not_applicable_with_rationale.physical_residue_after_erasure: Physical erasure is outside scope because this scenario has no independently observable physical-substrate erasure channel.

threat_model.mechanism_boundary: No universal cryptographic mechanism is required. The realization must expose the preregistered failure/uncertainty semantics for applicable adversarial cases.

oracle_authority.evaluator_input: implementation-neutral observations and preregistered fixture identities
execution_admission_requires: machine-readable fixture/oracle package derived only from this plan
standalone evaluator tests passing before subject implementation execution
pinned Rust toolchain and experimental source boundary
static scope audit proving no product runtime/profile integration
